text:
alex_g: heads up — we need increased p4d/p5/g5 capacity in ap-southeast-4 for a new tenant pilot (anthem). target start next week, peak concurrent ~18 GPUs. can infra lift quotas and check ENI/SNAT headroom?

maria_l: which account is this for and do we need AZ spread or single-AZ? also do we want dedicated (reserved) or spot fallback?

alex_g: account id 987654321098. prefer dedicated but want spot fallback to keep costs down during spike. need AZ spread across 3 AZs.

chris_ops: noted. i'll run a quick cluster capacity check. do we have expected shapes per GPU type? p4d for training, p5 for inference, g5 for cheap burst.

alex_g: plan is 6x p4d, 8x p5, 10x g5 but we won't run all simultaneously. peak concurrent is ~18. request is a soft ceiling bump to allow placement.

kate_net: FYI networking: ap-southeast-4 subnets are small in that account — current ENI limit is 250, SNAT throughput looks saturated at ~70% currently. we should request ENI bump to 1000 and increase NATGW throughput / allocate additional EIPs.

chris_ops: if we need 24 G instances we need enough IPv4 addresses in subnets and SNAT capacity. @kate_net can you paste the quick AWS support request snippet?

kate_net: sure — use this template when opening support case: 
```
Subject: Request for GPU instance and network quota increases for account 987654321098 in ap-southeast-4
Body:
- Account ID: 987654321098
- Region: ap-southeast-4
- Resources: EC2 P4d (p4d.24xlarge) quota to 10, EC2 P5 (p5.24xlarge) quota to 12, G5 (g5.24xlarge) quota to 16, Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI) to 1000, EIP per region to 200, NAT Gateway bandwidth increase or recommendation for additional NATs
- Justification: New tenant pilot requiring multi-AZ GPU capacity, peak concurrent ~18 GPUs, mix of training/inference. We operate a production inference platform and need placement flexibility.
- Desired timeframe: within 5 business days
```

quota-bot: AWS Support case created: case-0-1234567890-2026 (initial response ETA ~48hrs).

maria_l: thanks. also can we add a note: allow fallback policy routing to eu-west-2 if ap-southeast-4 placement fails? that'll keep prod traffic safe.

alex_g: yes please — add fallback routing to eu-west-2 and pre-warm small g5 pool there. cost team warned about cross-region egress but it's acceptable for pilot.

chris_ops: opened internal RFC for capacity: link https://redwood.internal/rfc/anthem-gpu-provisioning (quick notes: pre-provision 6x p5 in eu-west-2 as fallback, increase ENI quota, request dedicated capacity window).

kate_net: i'll file the ENI/EIP request and request extra NAT gateways. also recommend VPC subnet CIDR expansion (add /20) to avoid IP exhaustion.

alex_g: appreciated. timeline: we need confirmation by EOD tomorrow to proceed with tenant onboarding Monday.

maria_l: i'll follow up with AWS support threads and ping here when quota increases are approved. :thumbsup:

quota-bot: case-0-1234567890-2026 updated: AWS acknowledged and requested justification docs.

chris_ops: action items: (1) kate: open NATGW + ENI support case (2) maria: monitor AWS case and share updates (3) alex: confirm exact GPU start date and commit window. will reconvene in this thread.

alex_g: confirmed start date Monday 2026-03-30. thanks everyone.

maria_l: noted — last update please post case resolution here so we can close the onboarding checklist.
